Yeast is an ingredient of some preparations for treating haemorrhoids, and some preparations intended to restore normal gastrointestinal flora. Yeast is widely used in brewing. Antibiotic-associated colitis. Although other organisms, in- cluding Candida spp., have been implicated in antibiotic-associ- ated diarrhoea, colonisation of the colon with Clostridium diffi- cile, a toxin-producing Gram-positive anaerobe, is the most common identifiable cause of antibiotic-associated colitis (p.171) and pseudomembranous colitis. There are reports of ben- efit with dried yeast in patients with C. difficile-associated diar- rhoea;1,2 commercially available brewers’ yeast tablets were used, at a dose of 3 tablets three times daily (strength unspeci- fied), in 3 patients refractory to standard treatment,1 or as adjunc- tive therapy in 11 patients, using the same dose.2 1.
